items.name: Leather
items.description: A basic leather armor that provides minimal protection.

items.name: Studded Leather
items.description: A leather armor reinforced with metal studs, offering better protection.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description: A type of armor consisting of small metal rings linked together in a pattern to form a mesh.
items.effect: EVADE and SNEAKING rolls take a bane.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description: A type of armor made from large metal plates, providing excellent protection.
items.effect: ACROBATICS, EVADE, and SNEAKING rolls take a bane.

items.name: Open Helmet
items.description: A helmet that provides basic head protection.

items.name: Great Helm
items.description: A helmet that provides better head protection.
items.effect: AWARENESS rolls and every ranged attack take a bane.
